..Thru the Bible - Sunday Sermon  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

We live in a dark world full of rebellion and hostility against the righteousness of God and His Word. But against that dark backdrop, God has provided a light: The Savior. Scripture reveals the beauty of His character as one who is compassionate to those who live in the hopelessness of sin.

References: Leviticus 2

The wonder of the Word

“If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.” This is the laboratory test that He gives. There must be this attitude of a love for the Word of God. Someone has said that human knowledge must be known to be loved, but divine knowledge must be loved to be understood. So we have here, I think, these steps. You have knowledge and love and obedience. This is the test. This is what He asks you to do. That’s the wonder of the Word of God. If you’re willing, friends, God will make it real to you.

There is nothing in this life that will cause God to stop loving or caring for you.
